units: <cite ref="Nazir 37a:15">Naz. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>אי תְרוּ ליה וכ׳</he> if they steep it (meat) in milk for an entire day &c.
<cite ref="Gittin 27a:8">Gitt. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>בדוכתא היכא דתרו כיתנא</he> in the place where they steep flax.
<cite ref="Gittin 69b:8">Ib. 69ᵇ</cite> <he>ונִיתְרֵיה במיא</he> (not <he>וניתייריה</he>) and let him soak it in water.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 6:3">Targ. Y. Num. VI, 3</cite>.
